@pharos.pagination.label.description: Aria label for the pagination navigation region.

@pharos.pagination.previous.description: Aria label for the previous-page button.

@pharos.pagination.next.description: Aria label for the next-page button.

@pharos.pagination.goToPage.description: Aria label for an individual page-number button. `page` is 1-based.

@pharos.pagination.pageIndicators.description: Aria label for the dots-variant page-indicator group.

@pharos.pagination.count.description: Visible range-of-total text on a pagination bar. Example: "1–20 of 347"; the en-dash is translator's choice.

@pharos.pagination.pageOfTotal.description: Visible "Page X of Y" text on the compact pagination variant; also announced by screen readers. Keep short — sits in a compact toolbar.

@pharos.pagination.pageAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement when a page changes and total is unknown.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.field.description: Noun form-label above the field-picker dropdown in the PowerSearch filter-builder popover (which data column to filter on). Not an action.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.operator.description: Noun form-label above the operator dropdown in the PowerSearch filter-builder popover. Refers to a comparison verb ("is", "contains"), not a math or phone operator.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.addFilter.description: Button label inside a group in the PowerSearch filter-builder; adds another filter row (e.g. "Status = Active"). The leading "+ " is a plus-sign character.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.removeFilter.description: Screen-reader-only label on the "×" icon button next to a filter row in the PowerSearch editor; removes that row. Imperative verb.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.groupOperator.description: Screen-reader-only label for the AND/OR toggle that combines sibling filters inside a filter group. Sighted users see just "AND" or "OR".

@pharos.powersearch.editor.group.description: Fallback noun label shown on a nested filter-group chip when no AND/OR combining operator has been chosen. Use the noun ("a cluster"), not the verb "to group".

@pharos.powersearch.editor.delete.description: Button label inside the PowerSearch filter-editor popover; deletes the currently-edited filter row. Imperative verb form.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.cancel.description: Button label inside the PowerSearch filter-editor popover; closes the popover and discards pending edits. Imperative verb form.

@pharos.powersearch.editor.apply.description: Primary button label inside the PowerSearch filter-editor popover; confirms the edited filter. Imperative verb; consumers may override to "Save".

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.value.description: Noun form-label above a single free-text/number input in the PowerSearch value editor (e.g. the "acme" in `Name contains acme`). Not a verb or "worth".

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.values.description: Plural noun form-label above a multi-value chip input in the PowerSearch value editor. Should match its singular counterpart `Value` in your language.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.time.description: Noun form-label above a time-of-day (HH:MM) picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Clock time, not duration or era.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.date.description: Noun form-label above a calendar-date picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Calendar date, not romantic date or fruit.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.relative.description: Label for the relative-date selector (e.g. "Last 7 days") in the PowerSearch value editor.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.startDat.description: Noun form-label above the start-of-range date picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Pairs with `End date` — keep the two parallel in your language.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.endDate.description: Noun form-label above the end-of-range date picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Pairs with `Start date` — keep the two parallel.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.entities.description: "Entities" is jargon — plural noun form-label above an entity picker (people, teams, projects). Prefer a natural collective like "items" if your language has no equivalent.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.searchPl.description: Placeholder inside the search input in the PowerSearch entity/typeahead picker. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.enterVal.description: Placeholder inside a free-text single-value input in the PowerSearch value editor. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.addValue.description: Placeholder inside a multi-value chip input where the user types items and presses Enter to add each as a chip. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.enterNum.description: Placeholder inside a numeric input in the PowerSearch value editor. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.selectVa.description: Placeholder on a dropdown for choosing values from a fixed enum list in the PowerSearch value editor. Imperative verb (user selects, not types).

@pharos.powersearch.operator.contains.description: PowerSearch string operator, rendered inline as `<field> contains <value>` (e.g. `Name contains acme`). Lowercase verb form.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.notContains.description: PowerSearch negated string operator. Example: `Name does not contain test`. Lowercase; pairs with `contains`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.startsWith.description: PowerSearch string prefix operator. Example: `Email starts with admin@`. Lowercase.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.notStartsWi.description: PowerSearch negated prefix operator. Example: `Email does not start with test`. Lowercase; pairs with `starts with`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.endsWith.description: PowerSearch string suffix operator. Example: `Email ends with @meta.com`. Lowercase.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.notEndsWith.description: PowerSearch negated suffix operator. Example: `Email does not end with @gmail.com`. Lowercase; pairs with `ends with`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.is.description: PowerSearch equality operator for strings/enums. Example: `Status is Active`. Separate from `operator.equals` (numbers) — translations may diverge.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.isNot.description: PowerSearch inequality operator for strings/enums. Example: `Status is not Draft`. Pairs with `is`; separate from `operator.notEquals`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.equals.description: PowerSearch numeric equality operator. Example: `Age is 30`. Ships same English "is" as `operator.is` but is separate so numbers may diverge (e.g. "equals").

@pharos.powersearch.operator.notEquals.description: PowerSearch numeric inequality operator. Example: `Count is not 0`. Same divergence option as `operator.equals`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.greaterThan.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, strictly greater than. Example: `Age is greater than 18`. Lowercase.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.lessThan.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, strictly less than. Example: `Priority is less than 5`. Lowercase.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.greaterThan.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, ≥. Example: `Age is greater than or equal to 21`. A shorter form (e.g. "≥") is fine if idiomatic.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.lessThanOrE.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, ≤. Example: `Priority is less than or equal to 3`. A shorter form is fine if idiomatic.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.before.description: PowerSearch date operator, strictly earlier. Example: `Created is before 2024-01-01`. Temporal, not spatial.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.after.description: PowerSearch date operator, strictly later. Example: `Updated is after 2024-06-01`. Temporal.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.between.description: PowerSearch date operator, inclusive range. Example: `Created is between 2024-01-01 and 2024-06-30`. The `and <end>` portion is composed separately.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.isTrue.description: PowerSearch boolean operator: matches truthy. Example: `Is admin is true`. Pairs with `is false`; field may be affirmative or a yes/no question.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.isFalse.description: PowerSearch boolean operator: matches falsy. Example: `Is admin is false`. Pairs with `is true`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.isAnyOf.description: PowerSearch list operator: value is in the set. Example: `Status is any of [Active, Paused, Draft]`. The value list is composed separately; pairs with `is none of`.

@pharos.powersearch.operator.isNoneOf.description: PowerSearch negated list operator: value not in the set. Example: `Status is none of [Archived, Deleted]`. Pairs with `is any of`.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.itemsCou.description: Overflow summary on a compact filter chip when the list of selected items is too long. Example: `3 items` or `1 item`.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.entities.description: Overflow summary on a compact filter chip when the list of selected entities is too long. Example: `5 entities` or `1 entity`. Pair with `itemsCount` translation.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.dateRang.description: Fallback lowercase noun rendered inline in a filter chip when a date-range value can't be formatted (e.g. `Created is between date range`). Keep lowercase.

@pharos.powersearch.valueEditor.filtersC.description: Summary inside a filter chip when the value is a nested set of filters. Example: `3 filters` or `1 filter`.

@pharos.powersearch.resultCount.description: Live result-count text next to the PowerSearch input, announced to screen readers on change. Example: `12 results`, `1 result`; keep compact.

@pharos.alertDialog.cancel.description: Button label on the secondary/dismiss button of an AlertDialog (modal confirmation). Imperative verb; consumers usually override with task-specific text.

@pharos.appShell.mobileNavigation.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the mobile-only navigation region on small viewports. "Mobile" = phone/tablet (small screen), not "movable".

@pharos.avatar.nameWithStatus.description: Screen-reader accessible name for an Avatar showing a status indicator; composes the person's name with the status label, e.g. "Jane Doe, Online". {name} = the avatar's name/alt text, {status} = the status dot's label. Adjust separator and order per locale.

@pharos.avatarGroup.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a horizontal cluster of user avatar images. Plural noun; consumers usually override with "Team members", "Attendees", etc.

@pharos.avatarGroup.keyboardHint.defaultMessage: Use as setas para passar de um avatar a outro
@pharos.avatarGroup.keyboardHint.description: Screen-reader-only instruction attached (via aria-describedby) to a group of interactive avatars that share a single Tab stop. Tells keyboard users the Left/Right arrow keys move focus between the avatars. Only announced when the group has interactive (link/button) avatars.

@pharos.banner.dismiss.description: "Dismiss" = close/hide this notification (not "reject a person"). Aria label AND tooltip on the small X button on a Banner.

@pharos.calendar.previousMonth.description: Screen-reader-only label on the left-arrow button in a Calendar's month header (navigates one month back). Pairs with `calendar.nextMonth`.

@pharos.calendar.nextMonth.description: Screen-reader-only label on the right-arrow button in a Calendar's month header (navigates one month forward). Pairs with `calendar.previousMonth`.

@pharos.calendar.daySelected.description: Accessible name for the Calendar day button that is the current single-mode selection. `{date}` is the localized full date, e.g. "Thursday, January 15, 2026". The trailing state word tells screen-reader users the focused day is selected.

@pharos.calendar.dayRangeStart.description: Accessible name for the Calendar day button that begins the selected date range (or the first pick of an in-progress range). `{date}` is the localized full date.

@pharos.calendar.dayRangeEnd.description: Accessible name for the Calendar day button that ends the selected date range. `{date}` is the localized full date. Pairs with `calendar.dayRangeStart`.

@pharos.calendar.dayRangeStartAndEnd.description: Accessible name for a Calendar day button that both begins and ends a completed one-day range. `{date}` is the localized full date.

@pharos.calendar.dayInRange.description: Accessible name for a Calendar day button strictly inside the selected date range (not an endpoint). `{date}` is the localized full date.

@pharos.calendar.rangeStartAnnounce.defaultMessage: Data inicial {date}. Selecione a data final.
@pharos.calendar.rangeStartAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement after the first pick of a Calendar range selection. `{date}` is the localized full date. Prompts the user that a second pick completes the range.

@pharos.calendar.rangeCompleteAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement after the second pick completes a Calendar range selection. `{start}` and `{end}` are localized full dates in chronological order.

@pharos.carousel.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a horizontally-scrolling row of items. If "carousel" is unfamiliar in your locale, prefer the standard term (e.g. "slider").

@pharos.carousel.scrollLeft.description: Screen-reader-only label on the left arrow button in a Carousel. Pairs with `carousel.scrollRight`; in RTL locales, coordinate the two so left/right match layout.

@pharos.carousel.scrollRight.description: Screen-reader-only label on the right arrow button in a Carousel. Pairs with `carousel.scrollLeft`; same RTL note.

@pharos.carousel.slideLabel.description: Screen-reader accessible name for one slide in a Carousel, giving its position. `current` is the 1-based slide number; `total` is the slide count.

@pharos.chat.status.sending.description: Chat send-status caption under an outgoing message while it is being transmitted. Part of the set sending → sent → delivered → read (or failed) — keep tense/aspect consistent.

@pharos.chat.status.sent.description: Chat send-status caption shown once the message reaches the server. Part of the set sending → **sent** → delivered → read (or failed) — keep tense consistent.

@pharos.chat.status.delivered.description: Chat send-status caption shown once the recipient's device received the message. Part of the set sending → sent → **delivered** → read (or failed).

@pharos.chat.status.read.description: Chat send-status caption shown once the recipient opened the message. English past-participle ("has been read", /rɛd/), not the present verb — part of the set sending → sent → delivered → **read**.

@pharos.chat.status.failed.description: Chat send-status caption shown when the send attempt errored. Part of the set — the terminal failure branch, orthogonal to the sent → delivered → read success track.

@pharos.chat.messageAriaLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a chat message row. `{status}` interpolates the localized status word (e.g. `Message sent`, `Message delivered`) — reorder if needed.

@pharos.chat.pastedText.expand.description: Button label on a chip in the chat composer representing a long pasted text block; clicking reveals full content. "Expand" here means reveal more, not grow physically.

@pharos.checkboxList.item.checkbox.description: Screen-reader-only last-ditch fallback name for a checkbox inside a list item when no label is provided. Should almost never render — consumers should supply a real label.

@pharos.commandPalette.emptySearch.description: Fallback empty-state text inside a CommandPalette when the user's query has no matches. Very short (2 words); neutral tone.

@pharos.commandPalette.emptyBootstrap.description: Onboarding empty-state text shown inside a CommandPalette on first open, before the user has typed anything. Imperative sentence fragment.

@pharos.commandPalette.resultCount.description: Screen-reader-only announcement of how many commands match the CommandPalette query as the user types. Example: `12 results`, `1 result`; keep compact.

@pharos.commandPalette.noResultsFor.description: Screen-reader-only announcement when a CommandPalette query matches nothing. `{query}` is the user's verbatim search text; keep it last if your language allows so truncation-by-AT still conveys the outcome.

@pharos.commandPalette.loading.description: Screen-reader-only announcement that a CommandPalette search has started and results are being fetched. Present-progressive form; matches the visible spinner.

@pharos.dateRangeInput.presetDateRanges.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the sidebar of quick-pick preset ranges inside a DateRangeInput popover (e.g. "Last 7 days", "This month").

@pharos.dateTimeInput.timePlaceholder.description: Grey placeholder inside the empty time-of-day slot in a DateTimeInput. "Time" = clock time (HH:MM), not duration.

@pharos.dialog.close.description: "Close" = shut/dismiss the dialog, not "nearby" (English homograph). Aria label AND tooltip on the X at the top-right of a Dialog.

@pharos.dropdownMenu.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a dropdown menu popover. Very generic; consumers usually override. Noun ("a menu"), not the imperative.

@pharos.lightbox.close.description: "Close" = shut/dismiss (not "nearby"). Screen-reader-only label on the X button that dismisses a Lightbox.

@pharos.lightbox.previous.description: Screen-reader-only label on the left-arrow button in a Lightbox (navigates to previous media item). Pairs with `lightbox.next`.

@pharos.lightbox.next.description: Screen-reader-only label on the right-arrow button in a Lightbox (navigates to next media item). Pairs with `lightbox.previous`.

@pharos.markdown.taskList.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a GitHub-flavored Markdown task list (rendered from `- [ ] item` / `- [x] done` syntax).

@pharos.markdown.table.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a table rendered inside a Markdown block. Noun ("a table"), not the verb. Separate from `@pharos.table.label` — translations may diverge.

@pharos.mobileNav.closeNavigation.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X/close button that dismisses the MobileNav overlay. Pairs with `mobileNav.toggle.open`.

@pharos.multiSelector.selectAll.description: Label on the checkbox/toggle at the top of a MultiSelector dropdown that selects every option. "All" is a determiner here (as in "all the options"), not the pronoun.

@pharos.multiSelector.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the search input at the top of a MultiSelector's dropdown panel. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.multiSelector.searchOptions.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for that same search input inside a MultiSelector.

@pharos.popover.close.description: "Close" = shut/dismiss, not "nearby". Screen-reader-only label on the close button inside a Popover.

@pharos.selector.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the search input at the top of a Selector's dropdown panel (for filtering options). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.selector.searchOptions.description: "Options" = the list of choices in the dropdown. Screen-reader-only accessible name for the search input inside a Selector.

@pharos.sideNav.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the primary vertical sidebar nav (usually on the left).

@pharos.sideNav.resizeSidebar.description: Screen-reader-only label on the vertical drag handle at the right edge of the SideNav that lets the user resize the sidebar's width.

@pharos.sideNav.heading.openMenu.description: Screen-reader-only label on the `⋯` overflow-menu button embedded in a SideNav section heading. Same string as `topNav.heading.openMenu` — translations may share.

@pharos.tabList.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a horizontal tab bar. Plural noun; "Tabs" here = UI tab panels, not browser tabs or the Tab key.

@pharos.table.label.description: Fallback screen-reader-only accessible name for a data-table region when the consumer provides none. Noun ("a table"), not the verb "to table".

@pharos.table.noData.description: Fallback empty-state text in the table body when there are zero rows. Neutral tone (not error-y); consumers commonly override with something specific like "No results".

@pharos.table.filter.allPlaceholder.description: Placeholder on a per-column filter dropdown when nothing is selected, meaning "no filter — all rows match". Determiner form (as in "all values"), not the pronoun.

@pharos.table.filter.reset.description: Button label inside a table's filter panel/popover; clears pending filter values back to defaults. Imperative verb.

@pharos.table.filter.apply.description: Primary button label inside a table's filter panel/popover; commits pending filter values. Imperative verb; pairs with `Reset`.

@pharos.table.selection.selectAllRows.description: Aria label for the "select all rows" checkbox in a Table header.

@pharos.table.selection.selectRow.description: Aria label for the "select row" checkbox on a Table row.

@pharos.table.selection.selectRowNamed.description: Aria label for a Table row's selection checkbox when a per-row label is available (via getRowLabel). `label` is the row's human-readable identity, e.g. "Alice".

@pharos.table.sort.ascending.description: Screen-reader-only label on a column header button that will sort the column ascending. Part of a set with `sort.descending` and `sort.clear` — keep parallel.

@pharos.table.sort.descending.description: Screen-reader-only label on a column header button that will sort the column descending. Part of a set with `sort.ascending` and `sort.clear`.

@pharos.table.sort.clear.description: Screen-reader-only label on a column header button that will remove the current sort. "Clear" here means remove, not transparent. Part of the sort set.

@pharos.table.sort.direction.ascending.description: Localized direction word interpolated as `direction` into @pharos.table.sort.sortedBy and @pharos.table.sort.sortedByWithPriority.

@pharos.table.sort.direction.descending.description: Localized direction word interpolated as `direction` into @pharos.table.sort.sortedBy and @pharos.table.sort.sortedByWithPriority.

@pharos.table.sort.sortBy.description: Aria label for a sortable Table header button when the column is unsorted. `label` is the column header text.

@pharos.table.sort.sortedBy.description: Aria label for a sorted Table header button. `direction` is the localized direction word from @pharos.table.sort.direction.*.

@pharos.table.sort.sortedByWithPriority.defaultMessage: Ordenar por {label}, em ordem {direction}, prioridade {rank, number} de {total, number}
@pharos.table.sort.sortedByWithPriority.description: Aria label for a sorted Table header button in multi-sort. `rank` is the 1-based position of this column in the sort order; `total` is the number of sorted columns.

@pharos.toast.dismiss.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X button of a Toast (transient notification popup). Distinct from `banner.dismiss` (persistent banner).

@pharos.toast.viewport.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the invisible landmark region hosting the stack of Toast popups (usually pinned to a screen corner).

@pharos.tokenizer.clearAll.description: Label on the "×" button that removes every token/chip from a Tokenizer input. Imperative verb + determiner "all"; short.

@pharos.topNav.heading.openMenu.description: Screen-reader-only label on the `⋯` overflow button in a TopNav section heading. Kept separate from `sideNav.heading.openMenu` so translations may diverge.

@pharos.topNav.landmarkLabel.description: Default accessible name (aria-label) for the <nav> landmark rendered by TopNav when no label is provided.

@pharos.treeList.toggleChildren.description: "Children" = child nodes in the tree, not human children. Screen-reader-only label on the chevron next to a TreeList item that has children — toggles the sub-list.

@pharos.typeahead.emptySearchResults.description: Fallback empty-state message inside a Typeahead's suggestion popover when the current query has no matches. Neutral tone (not error-y).

@pharos.typeahead.loading.description: Screen-reader-only name for a spinner shown inside a Typeahead dropdown while suggestions are being fetched. Present-progressive form.

@pharos.typeahead.searchResults.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the list of suggestions inside a Typeahead dropdown.

@pharos.typeahead.clearSelection.description: "Selection" = the chosen value (not highlighted text). Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the currently-selected value from a Typeahead.

@pharos.breadcrumbs.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the breadcrumb trail (e.g. `Home > Section > Page`). Singular in English per ARIA convention; plural is fine if natural in your locale.

@pharos.chat.composer.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder text inside the empty chat composer textarea. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.chat.composerDrawer.label.description: Fallback aria label for the ChatComposerDrawer — a horizontal list of attachment/tool chips. Consumers usually override with "Attachments", "Tools", etc.

@pharos.chat.composerInput.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the chat composer textarea. Reorder freely if your language uses one word for "message field".

@pharos.chat.speechRecognition.noSpeechD.description: Full-sentence error shown inline in the chat composer after voice input captured silence. Soft-error tone (not alarming); keep terminal period.

@pharos.commandPalette.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a keyboard-driven command menu (usually opened with Cmd/Ctrl-K). If unfamiliar, prefer a natural equivalent like "quick actions".

@pharos.commandPalette.input.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside the CommandPalette's search input. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.commandPalette.list.label.description: "Command" = an app action a user can invoke (metaphor from CLI), not a Unix command. Screen-reader-only name for the matching-commands list.

@pharos.contextMenu.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the right-click / long-press popup menu. "Context" = context-specific to the activated element, not linguistic context.

@pharos.dateInput.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside an empty DateInput field. "Date" = calendar date, not romantic or fruit. Imperative verb.

@pharos.dateInput.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the popover dialog opened from a DateInput's calendar toggle. Imperative verb + noun.

@pharos.dateInput.closeCalendar.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X inside the DateInput calendar popover (dismisses the popover). Distinct from `dateInput.toggleCalendarClose`, which labels the outer toggle.

@pharos.dateInput.openCalendar.description: Aria label for the DateInput / DateRangeInput / DateTimeInput calendar toggle button when the popover is closed.

@pharos.dateInput.toggleCalendarClose.description: Aria label for the DateInput / DateRangeInput / DateTimeInput calendar toggle button when the popover is open. Distinct from closeCalendar (which labels the X inside the popover) so translators can differentiate the toggle vs the close-X UI.

@pharos.dateInput.clear.description: Aria label for the clear-value button in DateInput / DateRangeInput / DateTimeInput. `{label}` is the field's own label so screen readers announce e.g. 'Clear Start date'.

@pharos.dateTimeInput.timeSuffix.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the time-of-day slot in a DateTimeInput. Example: `Start date time`; reorder freely (e.g. "time of {label}").

@pharos.dateRangeInput.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside an empty DateRangeInput field. Represents picking a start–end date pair. Imperative verb.

@pharos.dateRangeInput.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the popover dialog opened from a DateRangeInput. Imperative verb + noun phrase.

@pharos.dateTimeInput.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside an empty DateTimeInput field. Note: the English says only "date" though the field is date+time — do not add "and time" unless natural.

@pharos.dateTimeInput.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the DateTimeInput picker dialog. Same English-only "date" phrasing as the placeholder — don't add "and time" unless natural.

@pharos.link.newTab.description: Visually-hidden (screen-reader-only) suffix appended to a Link's accessible name when it opens in a new tab. Example: `Documentation (opens in new tab)`.

@pharos.mobileNav.toggle.open.description: Screen-reader-only label on the hamburger button that opens the MobileNav overlay (rendered when the overlay is closed). Pairs with `mobileNav.closeNavigation`.

@pharos.moreMenu.label.description: Screen-reader-only name for the small `⋯` (three-dots) overflow button that opens a menu of additional actions. Very short — sits on a tiny icon button.

@pharos.multiSelector.selectPlaceholder.description: Placeholder on an empty MultiSelector trigger button. Same English as `selector.placeholder` but a separate key — plural phrasing like "Choose items…" is fine.

@pharos.outline.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a page's outline / table-of-contents sidebar (list of in-page headings). Rendered as `aria-label` on a `<nav>` landmark.

@pharos.powersearch.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the PowerSearch input (a filter-builder). The visible placeholder is separate; noun form often reads better than the verb.

@pharos.powersearch.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder text inside the empty PowerSearch input. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.resizable.handle.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the small draggable divider between two Resizable panels (users drag it to change the split ratio).

@pharos.selector.placeholder.description: Placeholder text on an empty Selector trigger button (a dropdown). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character. Very short — appears on the button face.

@pharos.sideNav.heading.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the dropdown dialog opened from a SideNavHeading's overflow menu.

@pharos.table.pagination.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the pagination `<nav>` appended below a data table. Kept separate from `@pharos.pagination.label` so translations may diverge.

@pharos.timeInput.placeholder.description: "Time" = clock time (HH:MM), not duration or era. Grey placeholder inside an empty TimeInput field; imperative verb.

@pharos.topNav.heading.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the dropdown dialog opened from a TopNavHeading's overflow menu. Kept separate from the SideNav sibling.

@pharos.typeahead.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside an empty Typeahead input (a search field that suggests results as the user types). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@pharos.banner.collapse.description: "Collapse" = fold up, not crumble. Aria label AND tooltip on the Banner expand/collapse toggle when currently expanded. Pairs with `banner.expand`.

@pharos.banner.expand.description: "Expand" = reveal more, not grow physically. Aria label AND tooltip on the same toggle when currently collapsed. Pairs with `banner.collapse`.

@pharos.chatComposerDrawer.expand.description: Screen-reader-only label on the ChatComposerDrawer toggle when the drawer is collapsed. `{label}` is the drawer's visible name — example: `Expand Attachments`. Pairs with `collapse`.

@pharos.chatComposerDrawer.collapse.description: Screen-reader-only label on the ChatComposerDrawer toggle when the drawer is expanded. Example: `Collapse Attachments`. Pairs with `expand`.

@pharos.chatDictationButton.startDictati.description: Accessible label for the microphone button when idle (not listening).

@pharos.chatDictationButton.stopDictatio.description: Accessible label for the microphone button when actively listening.

@pharos.chatLayout.newMessages.description: Text on a floating pill at the bottom of a chat viewport when unseen messages arrive below the fold; clicking scrolls to bottom. Keep short — narrow pill.

@pharos.chatLayoutScrollButton.scrollToB.description: Visible tooltip AND screen-reader label for a small down-arrow button that scrolls the chat viewport to its latest message.

@pharos.chatMessage.messageFrom.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a chat message when the sender name isn't visible. Example: `Message from Sarah`, `Message from Bot` — reorder freely.

@pharos.chatSendButton.stop.description: Button label that replaces `Send` on the chat send button while an AI response is streaming; clicking aborts generation. Short — appears on a small button.

@pharos.chatSendButton.send.description: Primary button label on the chat submit button (paperplane icon). Imperative verb; pairs with `Stop`. Very short.

@pharos.chatToolCalls.error.description: Screen-reader text for a tool call that failed. {message} is the error detail.

@pharos.chatToolCalls.groupLabel.description: Summary label shown in the group header when multiple tool calls are expanded. {count} is the number of calls.

@pharos.chatTriggerMenu.suggestions.description: Screen-reader-only fallback label for the popover listbox opened by a trigger character (`@`, `/`) in the chat composer when the trigger provides no specific label.

@pharos.citation.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a Citation chip (a small numbered link to a source). Example: `Citation 1: OpenAI research paper`. Reorder freely.

@pharos.codeBlock.copied.description: Screen-reader-only label on the CodeBlock copy button for ~2s after a successful copy. Past-participle ("has been copied"); pairs with `codeBlock.copyCode`.

@pharos.codeBlock.copyCode.description: "Code" = source code. Aria label AND tooltip on the CodeBlock copy button in its default state. Pairs with `codeBlock.copied` (post-click state).

@pharos.codeBlock.code.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a code-snippet scroll container when the code's language is unknown. "Code" = source code, not secret code or code of conduct.

@pharos.fileInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that removes the selected file from a FileInput. Example: `Clear Attachment`, `Clear Résumé`.

@pharos.fileInput.required.description: Screen-reader-only description on the FileInput trigger indicating the field must be filled in. Mirrors the visible `Required` indicator next to the field label; conveyed via description because aria-required is not supported on role="button".

@pharos.fileInput.triggerWithFiles.description: Accessible name for a FileInput trigger that has files attached, composing the field label with the selected filenames. Example: `Attachments, report.pdf, notes.txt`.

@pharos.lightbox.mediaViewer.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the Lightbox dialog when the current media item has no alt text. Should rarely render — consumers should provide alt.

@pharos.mobileNav.navigation.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the MobileNav overlay dialog when no explicit label was passed.

@pharos.multiSelector.clearAll.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears every selected value from a MultiSelector. Example: `Clear all Countries`. `{label}` is typically already plural in English.

@pharos.input.statusButton.error.description: Accessible name for the focusable status icon button inside an input when statusVariant is 'tooltip' and the status type is error. Activating or focusing the button reveals the error message in a tooltip. Keep it short — it labels an icon-only button.

@pharos.input.statusButton.warning.description: Accessible name for the focusable status icon button inside an input when statusVariant is 'tooltip' and the status type is warning. Activating or focusing the button reveals the warning message in a tooltip.

@pharos.input.statusButton.success.description: Accessible name for the focusable status icon button inside an input when statusVariant is 'tooltip' and the status type is success. Activating or focusing the button reveals the success message in a tooltip.

@pharos.numberInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the value from a NumberInput. Example: `Clear Age`, `Clear Quantity`.

@pharos.selector.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the selected value from a Selector. `{label}` is the selector's visible label — example: `Clear Country`.

@pharos.sideNavCollapseButton.expandSide.description: Aria label AND tooltip on the SideNav collapse/expand toggle when the sidebar is currently collapsed (clicking expands it). Pairs with `collapseSidebar`.

@pharos.sideNavCollapseButton.collapseSi.description: Aria label AND tooltip on the same toggle when the sidebar is currently expanded (clicking collapses it). Pairs with `expandSidebar`.

@pharos.sideNavItem.expand.description: Screen-reader-only label on the chevron next to a SideNav item with children when the group is collapsed. Example: `Expand Settings`. Pairs with `sideNavItem.collapse`.

@pharos.sideNavItem.collapse.description: Screen-reader-only label on the same chevron when the group is expanded. Example: `Collapse Settings`. Pairs with `sideNavItem.expand`.

@pharos.tableFiltering.filterByColumn.description: Triple-use string on per-column filter controls: visible label, placeholder, AND aria label. `{header}` is the column header — example: `Filter Name`. Keep short.

@pharos.tableGroupedRows.expandGroup.description: Screen-reader-only label on the chevron next to a grouped table's group header when collapsed. Example: `Expand group Q1 2024`. Pairs with `collapseGroup`.

@pharos.tableGroupedRows.collapseGroup.description: Screen-reader-only label on the same chevron when the group is expanded. Example: `Collapse group Q1 2024`. Pairs with `expandGroup`.

@pharos.tableRowExpansion.collapseRow.description: Screen-reader-only label on the row-expand chevron when the row is currently expanded. Part of the four-way expand/collapse set.

@pharos.tableRowExpansion.expandRow.description: Screen-reader-only label on the row-expand chevron when the row is currently collapsed. Part of a four-way set with `collapseRow`, `expandAllRows`, `collapseAllRows`.

@pharos.tableRowExpansion.collapseAllRow.description: Screen-reader-only label on the same header button when every row is expanded. Part of the four-way set.

@pharos.tableRowExpansion.expandAllRows.description: Screen-reader-only label on the header expand-all/collapse-all button when at least one row is collapsed (clicking expands every expandable row). Part of the four-way set.

@pharos.tableTree.collapseRow.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data expander chevron when the row is currently expanded.

@pharos.tableTree.expandRow.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data expander chevron when the row is currently collapsed.

@pharos.tableTree.collapseAllRows.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data header toggle when all rows are expanded and clicking it collapses them.

@pharos.tableTree.expandAllRows.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data header toggle when rows are collapsed and clicking it expands them.

@pharos.textInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the value from a TextInput. Example: `Clear Email`, `Clear Name`.

@pharos.textInput.showPasswordLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the eye toggle that reveals or hides a password TextInput. The toggle's pressed state (aria-pressed) tells whether the password is visible, so the label stays the same.

@pharos.thumbnail.remove.description: Screen-reader-only label on the "×" on a Thumbnail (image preview chip). `{accessibleName}` is the thumbnail's name — example: `Remove profile.jpg`.

@pharos.thumbnail.open.description: "Open" = launch/reveal (not "unfold" or the adjective). Screen-reader-only name on a clickable Thumbnail — example: `Open Sunset photo`.

@pharos.thumbnail.fallbackName.description: Generic screen-reader name for a Thumbnail (image preview) that has no `alt` or `label`. Last-resort fallback so the control is never nameless; prefer a real name via `alt` or `label`.

@pharos.timeInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the value from a TimeInput. Example: `Clear Start time`.

@pharos.token.remove.description: Screen-reader-only label on the "×" on an individual Token/chip. Example: `Remove John Smith`, `Remove Active`. Imperative verb.

@pharos.field.optional.description: Screen-visible suffix on a field label marking the field as not required. Single adjective, shown after a separator dot.

@pharos.field.required.description: Screen-visible suffix on a field label marking the field as mandatory. Single adjective, shown after a separator dot.

@pharos.fileInput.chooseFile.description: Default placeholder of a single-file FileInput before a file is chosen. Imperative verb.

@pharos.fileInput.chooseFiles.description: Default placeholder of a multiple-file FileInput before files are chosen. Imperative verb.

@pharos.fileInput.selectedOne.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after one file is attached to a FileInput. {name} is the file name.

@pharos.fileInput.selectedMany.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after several files are attached to a FileInput. {count} is a number greater than 1.

@pharos.fileInput.notAccepted.defaultMessage: "{name}" não é um tipo de arquivo aceito
@pharos.fileInput.notAccepted.description: Validation error when a file's type is not in the FileInput `accept` list. {name} is the file name.

@pharos.fileInput.exceedsLimit.description: Validation error when a file is larger than the FileInput `maxSize`. {name} is the file name, {limit} a formatted size such as `5 MB`.

@pharos.fileInput.tooManyFiles.description: Validation error when more files than the FileInput `maxFiles` are chosen. {count} is the maximum.

@pharos.appShell.skipToContent.description: Visible-on-focus link at the top of the AppShell that jumps keyboard users past the navigation to the main content.
